==Enemies==
'''Korblox''' may refer to these event enemies:
*[[Korblox Deathwalker (The Classic)]], a major boss that first appeared on Wave 12 in [[Classic Winter|The Classic Mission 2]], Wave 12 in [[Classic Island Chaos|The Classic Mission 4]], and Wave 12 in [[Classic Castle|The Classic Mission 5]]
*[[Korblox Deathwalker (The Hunt)]], a major boss that first appeared on Wave 10 on Beginner difficulty and Wave 15 on Hard difficulty in [[Huevous Hunt]]
*[[Korblox Deathwalker (The Hunt: Mega Edition)]], a major boss that first appeared on Wave 15 on Easy and Mega difficulty, and Wave 20 on Impossible difficulty in [[Korblox Temple]]
*[[Korblox General (The Classic)]], a strong enemy that first appeared on Wave 9 in [[Classic Winter|The Classic Mission 2]], Wave 8 in [[Classic Island Chaos|The Classic Mission 4]], and Wave 8 in [[Classic Castle|The Classic Mission 5]]
*[[Korblox General (The Hunt)]], a strong enemy that first appeared on Wave 8 in [[Huevous Hunt]]
**[[Korblox General (The Hunt)/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Korblox General (The Hunt: Mega Edition)]], a strong enemy that first appeared on Wave 8 in [[Korblox Temple]]
**[[Korblox General (The Hunt: Mega Edition)/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Korblox Guard (The Classic)]], an enemy that first appeared on Wave 1 in [[Classic Winter|The Classic Mission 2]], Wave 1 in [[Classic Island Chaos|The Classic Mission 4]], and Wave 2 in [[Classic Castle|The Classic Mission 5]]

*[[Korblox Necromancer]], a high health summoner enemy that could summon [[Korblox Undead (The Hunt: Mega Edition)|Korblox Undeads (The Hunt: Mega Edition)]] and [[Korblox Warrior (The Hunt: Mega Edition)|Korblox Warriors (The Hunt: Mega Edition)]], that first appeared on Wave 15 on Impossible difficulty in [[Korblox Temple]]
